There are unrelated as well as minor related to the patch CI fails (this and the child). Will fixup the latter soon. Not yet sure what the former is due to.

overall, looks good. It needs a bit of love stylistically but my preference would be to 

1. fix up the tidy errors
2. pick off the low hanging fruit
3. test the crap out of it
4. land this feature
5. followup with stylistic/preference fixes (I agree with much of what Harshit has said here, i.e. making this a class and adding more granularity on config fixes).

I think we should add support for multiple NvidiaMctpVdm configuration (one for each device) in Entity Configuration. For example separate configuration for SMAs and CXs. We can add a `DeviceName` property in the Platform config and then match the value of that property in the Entity config to pick the relevant config. We can also introduce separate config type for each device type, NvidiaMctpVdmGpu, NvidiaMctpVdmSMA, etc. This will help when we have certain configuration properties that are only applicable for a particular device type, number of network ports on CXs for example.
Agree, although again will bring this improvement in a new commit. It would also help if you post similar comment on the EM config itself stating how that should change.

nit: having all this function as free function (as oppose to class member functions) is unnecessarily increasing lines of code in my opinion as we have to pass same set of function parameters to each function. Once we add support for MCTP rediscovery we anyway have to introduce class based design as we have to maintain state.
Agree, and can do this once we require to maintain state beyond what these functions already use (a set of globals).

So we can directly specify `inventoryPath` here to limit the search space and we might also not need the check at line number 196?

This is a good suggesiton but atm not possible because mapper doesn't accept an empty interface list (which is what we would want to do to not assume any specific MCTP over X interfaces). I can follow up with fixes to mapper and then here in a separate commit.

We might have additional configurations than just name and pollrate in future. We already have NumberOfNetworkPorts for CX for example. Putting then in class avoids unnecessary changes in functions/constructors declarations each time we add a new config.
I'd vote we don't respin this change series for this, we've been waiting too long for these features. We can always bring this struct back IMO.
Agree, although I will do the refactor in a separate commit.

don't we need to watch for changes on the association to remove devices if the SMA is put it into reset and falls off the bus? if I'm missing how this is handled, feel free to point me at the code 😊. Other than that looks fine if we're going with the current model, though this looks like its full of sharp corners.
